title: Flatness under constant-scalar realization
statement: Let T be a scheme and A an arbitrary commutative ring. Let E be the canonical equivalence from A-module valued sheaves on the small etale site of T to module sheaves over the constant commutative ring sheaf, using etaleConstantModuleFunctor followed by the canonical ring-isomorphism pushforward. For every module-valued sheaf F, ObjectProperty.flat F holds if and only if IsFlatOnSite (E F) holds. Both flatness predicates mean exactness of tensor; the first includes both tensor orders, which are naturally isomorphic by symmetry.

source.place: Tags 093I and 03CV (constant-scalar equivalence), 03EK and 03ER (tensor and flatness)

proof.text: Apply the natural right-tensor comparison of lem-pur-etale-constant-module-tensor. The realization is an equivalence because both constant-scalar realization and canonical ring transport are equivalences. Conjugating with its inverse identifies exactness of the two right-tensor functors. Conversely, the realization reflects finite limits and colimits, so exactness transfers back. Tensor symmetry recovers left tensoring from right tensoring. This proves both directions, including the zero ring and empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Sections 03EK, 03ER, 093I and 03CV; natural tensor comparison and exactness transport by the canonical equivalence.

theorem etaleConstantModule_flat_iff (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    ObjectProperty.flat F ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := T.smallEtaleTopology) (R :=
        (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of A))
        ((etaleConstantModuleFunctor T A ⋙
          SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := 𝟭 T.Etale)
            (constantModuleHomRingIso T.smallEtaleTopology A).inv).obj F)
